items.rationale: Rainwater entered from outside, so this is flood under 2.5, not escape of water under 2.4. No further natural hazards cover is shown, so 3.6.2(b) bars the labour; the conditional estimate is 12 hours at €95 gross.
Section 3.6.2(f) bars all journey charges for this uninsured flood. If flood cover were established, this first attendance could qualify under 7.1.7(g) at about €70 gross.

Section 3.6.2(d) bars flood mitigation equipment, and 5.2.2 independently disallows separate pump procurement alongside the extraction charge. The positive estimate is a stand-alone gross cost placeholder.

Section 3.6.2(d) bars this equipment charge, and 5.2.2 would include the pump in the extraction measure rather than pay for it separately even on a covered loss. The positive estimate is a stand-alone deployment cost placeholder.

Section 3.6.2(d) bars extraction because further natural hazards cover is not shown. The conditional estimate is €450 gross for the complete pumping operation, including labour and equipment as required by 5.2.2.
Section 3.6.2(c) bars materials used to repair uninsured flood damage. The conditional €120 gross estimate allows only standard materials actually built into the rewiring under 7.1.7(c).

items.description: Boiler, flue and storage tank renewal
items.rationale: The fixed heating system is insured property, but 3.6.2(a) bars its replacement after a flood without further natural hazards cover. The conditional estimate is €11,000 gross for like-for-like installed renewal under 7.1.1(c), excluding the separately billed pipe adaptation and disposal.

Section 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work associated with replacement after an uninsured flood. The conditional €600 gross estimate is limited to necessary changes to immediately adjoining pipework under 7.1.7(d).
Section 3.6.2(e) bars removal and disposal because the underlying flood is not covered. The conditional €350 gross estimate covers ordinary haul-away and disposal under 5.2.1.

Section 3.6.2(f) bars this journey charge, and 7.1.8(d) would also exclude it as the second attendance charge even on a covered event. The positive estimate is a stand-alone attendance cost placeholder.
